source.description: Manager-visible Control 4-3-3 DM Wide starting-XI clipboard export from the running app, captured 2026-10-13 before template selection changes.
notes: Only exported visible attributes, names, ages, familiarity and lineup slots are preserved. Readiness, preferred feet and uncaptured identity fields remain null or explicit placeholders. Availability reflects inclusion in the selected XI.
Any missing player ID uses a capture-slot placeholder. No hidden values are included.
